headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, while the New York Yankees secured a comeback victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. In other action, the Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, and the Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles in a thrilling finish.

Top MLB news saw the Twins fall to the Guardians in a 13-4 loss, with Petey Halpin leading the Guardians' charge. The Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense. The Rays took down the Blue Jays 7-1, with Nick Martinez earning the win. The Red Sox came from behind to take a 6-5 victory over the Orioles, with Christian Encarnacion-Strand leading the Orioles' offense.

Injuries and availability impacts are affecting several teams. The Chicago White Sox placed catcher Kyle Teel on the 10-day injured list due to a left ankle sprain. The Boston Red Sox placed right-handed pitcher Zack Kelly on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Miami Marlins placed right-handed pitcher Max Meyer on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 19, 2026, due to a neck strain.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics. The Baltimore Orioles acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals. The Tampa Bay Rays traded right-handed pitcher Trey Pooser to the St. Louis Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 5-8 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel impressed on the mound with 3.0 scoreless innings, 5 strikeouts, and 1 hit allowed.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, coming from behind to take the win. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Place Kyle Teel on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox catcher Kyle Teel has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left ankle sprain.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
